title: 2021 Topps #135 Brandon Woodruff Milwaukee Brewers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps trading card featuring Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, part of the MLB as a baseball player. The card is not autographed and is part of the 2021 Topps set manufactured by Topps. It is a single trading card number 135, highlighting Woodruff's presence in the 2021 baseball season. This collectible item appeals to fans of baseball and trading card enthusiasts seeking to add a piece of the sport to their collection.
